operation.success_meaning: nonce, audit intent, operation receipt and exact download claim committed atomically; no claim of bytes sent
operation.status_relation: Operation/admission 200 is independent of GET stream full 200 or partial 206; final public Operation semantics require D review

signed_request_candidate.server_derivation: Authenticate real access JWT and current SQL session/RBAC/owner; load authorized immutable evidence manifest; parse Range against actual content size with existing parser
signed_request_candidate.session_convention: Exact existing RegistrationActor.Session digest, identical to signed ProofPayload.session; never the bearer token
signed_request_candidate.range_semantics: Inclusive byte offsets; absent Range and explicit full range remain distinct via range_present because response status differs
signed_request_candidate.idempotency_key: Separate signed ProofPayload.idempotency_key and transaction unique scope; not a new request-body field
signed_request_candidate.server_generated_claim: Not known when proof is signed. Bind it through the immutable admission receipt and nonce.operation_id in the SAME claim/audit transaction

transaction_anchor_candidate.nonce_result: operation_id references new admission operation; response_sha256 stays SQL NULL
transaction_anchor_candidate.response_storage: Separate bounded immutable inline diagnostic evidence under system owner, with exact JCS bytes/hash and retention; no plaintext evidence/provider URI/raw proof/raw nonce
transaction_anchor_candidate.audit_api_change: Provide the actual INSERT audit_logs.id from the original transaction, compare the stored row, and use it for the nonce FK; never SELECT MAX or a guessed ID
final_guards: fresh SQL UTC after all callbacks
transaction_anchor_candidate.commit_unknown: Withhold provider reads and plaintext; do not automatically consume another nonce or replay the prior admission to send bytes

retry_recommendation.same_key_same_hash: Return conflict for a previously committed admission; never resend on the old operation/proof
retry_recommendation.after_provider_failure_disconnect_or_rev: Keep original nonce/admission immutable; record a separate result audit; a new attempt needs fresh key and proof after current claim/session checks
retry_recommendation.transaction_rollback: No consumed nonce or committed admission; normal proof lifetime and current auth still apply
retry_recommendation.result_audit: Distinguish admission, read failure, cancellation and local write completion; local write completion does not prove client receipt
